PREPLANNING_CONTEXT: {"version":1,"schema_version":2,"epicId":"69e8-af39-7886-4ee9","generatedAt":"2026-06-02T00:00:00Z","generatedBy":"preplanning","epic":{"title":"Test creation calibration (c): feedback loop from production bugs and review findings to test-creation prompts","description":"Negative-example capture from closed bugs, retrieval into test-writers, and graduation into the behavioral-testing standard.","successCriteria":["sc-1","sc-2","sc-3","sc-4","sc-5","sc-6","sc-7","sc-8","sc-9"]},"researchFindings":[],"stories":[{"id":"5b87-836f-0f29-448c","title":"As a DSO maintainer, I want a published NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE comment contract, so that extraction and graduation agents share one authoritative schema with correct-polarity guidance.","description":"## Description
**What**: Publish plugins/dso/docs/contracts/negative-example-comment.md defining the NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE comment schema (schema_version=1, bug_type_slug, intent_ids_if_applicable, missed_signal_summary, what_test_would_have_caught_it, generalizable_lesson, related_files, scope_claim, falsification), plus prompt-engineering guidance for sonnet extraction to avoid inverted-polarity drafts, plus a style guide for opus graduation-rule drafting matching the existing 7-rule standard structure.
**Why**: This contract is the walking-skeleton foundation — every downstream extraction (SC2), retrieval (SC3), and graduation (SC5) reads from it. Inverted-polarity guidance is the load-bearing mitigation for the SC2 missed_signal_summary risk.
**Scope**:
- IN: contract markdown file; field-by-field schema; canonical correct-polarity missed_signal_summary example; vacuous-field examples for scope_claim/falsification; opus graduation-rule style guide section.
- OUT: the extraction logic itself (draft-2); the lookup script (draft-3); any agent prompt edits.","priority":0,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":true,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["plugins/dso/docs/contracts/negative-example-comment.md exists and documents every NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE field named in SC1 (schema_version, bug_type_slug, intent_ids_if_applicable, missed_signal_summary, what_test_would_have_caught_it, generalizable_lesson, related_files, scope_claim, falsification) ← Satisfies: sc-1","The contract includes a canonical missed_signal_summary example demonstrating correct polarity (describing what FAILED to be detected) ← Satisfies: sc-1","The contract includes prompt-engineering guidance directing sonnet extraction away from inverted-polarity drafts, plus a consistent style guide for opus drafting of graduation rules ← Satisfies: sc-1","The contract includes an opus graduation-rule style guide section whose 4-field structure (rule_statement, rationale, anti_pattern_example, correct_pattern_example) matches the existing behavioral-testing-standard.md 7-rule structure ← Satisfies: sc-1","A schema-conformance test validates that a sample NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE JSON matching the contract parses and a sample with a missing required field is rejected, and unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-1"],"considerations":["[Dependency] intent_ids_if_applicable values reference 94ed-f55c manifest entries; the contract must state values MUST reference real manifest entries OR be empty. External blocker: 94ed manifest vocabulary — do not redefine it here.","[Dependency] bug_type_slug values derive from the 4911-c7ba taxonomy; the contract references that taxonomy as the source of slugs rather than enumerating slugs inline.","[Risk] Inverted-polarity guidance is the primary spec-level mitigation for missed_signal_summary; the canonical example must be unambiguous."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":[],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-1"},{"id":"3256-ed96-73db-4012","title":"As a sprint orchestrator, I want closed-fixed bugs to be evaluated and recorded as NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE comments during /dso:fix-bug Phase G, so that test-miss lessons are captured atomically with privacy redaction and a skip audit trail.","description":"## Description
**What**: Extend /dso:fix-bug Phase G to run after the 4911-c7ba bug-type classification step. On a bug closed with reason="Fixed: ...", a sonnet sub-agent evaluates extraction conditions (not caught by an existing test AND generalizable), performs mandatory pre-extraction redaction of credentials/tokens/keys/PII/internal IDs, requires non-vacuous scope_claim and falsification fields, writes the NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE comment + negative-example tag atomically, falls back to bug_type_slug=unclassified + retro-needs-classification tag when 4911 did not set a slug, logs a SKIP_RECORD comment on every skip, and validates intent_ids_if_applicable against 94ed manifest entries at write time.
**Why**: This is the capture half of the walking-skeleton loop — without it the corpus is never populated.
**Scope**:
- IN: Phase G prompt/logic edits; sonnet extraction evaluation; redaction step; scope_claim/falsification vacuity gate; atomic comment+tag write with rollback; unclassified fallback; SKIP_RECORD audit comment; intent_id write-time validation.
- OUT: retrieval (draft-3); graduation (draft-5/6); lifecycle reopening hook (draft-7).","priority":0,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":true,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["Phase G extraction executes only after the 4911-c7ba bug-type classification step has run, and reads the bug_type_<slug> tag that step sets ← Satisfies: sc-2","On a closed-Fixed bug meeting extraction conditions (not caught by an existing test and generalizable pattern) the sonnet step produces a NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE comment whose missed_signal_summary describes what FAILED to be detected, and on a bug not meeting the conditions it produces a SKIP_RECORD comment with decision=skip and a one-sentence skip_reason ← Satisfies: sc-2","Credentials, tokens, keys, PII, customer/user identifiers, and internal-only IDs are redacted from all NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE string fields before write; when redaction confidence is insufficient the extraction is skipped and a SKIP_RECORD comment with decision=skip and a one-sentence skip_reason is emitted ← Satisfies: sc-2","When scope_claim or falsification is vacuous the extraction is skipped and a SKIP_RECORD comment with decision=skip and a one-sentence skip_reason is emitted, matching the SKIP_RECORD shape used by the conditions-not-met and redaction skip paths so every skip leaves an audit comment ← Satisfies: sc-2","The NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE comment plus negative-example tag are applied as a single atomic unit that rolls back if either write fails ← Satisfies: sc-2","When 4911 classification did not set bug_type_<slug>, the record uses bug_type_slug=unclassified and the ticket receives a retro-needs-classification tag; intent_ids_if_applicable values are validated against 94ed manifest entries at write time, with invalid values causing write failure or being dropped with a warning ← Satisfies: sc-2","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-2"],"considerations":["[Dependency] EXTERNAL BLOCKER: SC2 ordering requires 4911-c7ba's bug-type classification step to set bug_type_<slug>; do not create an in-epic depends_on for 4911 — coordinate via the documented cross-epic dependency.","[Dependency] EXTERNAL BLOCKER: intent_id validation reads 94ed-f55c manifest entries; the manifest schema is owned by 94ed.","[Risk] Inverted-polarity: missed_signal_summary must describe what FAILED to be detected, NOT what the test checks — assert polarity explicitly in tests using the canonical contract example.","[Privacy] Redaction is mandatory pre-write; a fixture bug carrying a token must result in redaction or a skip, never a leaked credential.","[CrossStory] The NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE and SKIP_RECORD comments must carry a reliable creation timestamp so draft-5's since-last-retro watermark can compare its cursor against them when counting examples_extracted_since_last_retro and examples_skipped_count (SC9(l)); stamp the timestamp at write time on both comment kinds.","[CrossEpic] 411b auto-created mutation-breach bugs flow through Phase G with no special handling per the epic cross-epic comment."],"scopeSplitCandidate":true,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["5b87-836f-0f29-448c"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-2"},{"id":"1b37-8ba6-0639-4cc2","title":"As a test-writing sub-agent, I want negative-examples-lookup.sh to retrieve the top-3 relevant learned examples for a task, so that I receive project-specific lessons filtered for relevance, staleness, and promotion state.","description":"## Description
**What**: Implement plugins/dso/scripts/negative-examples-lookup.sh that reads a task's file_impact + claimable_intent, queries closed negative-example bugs by bug-type slug via existing ticket-CLI primitives, excludes promoted-to-standard:* and stale (related_files referencing on-disk-missing paths) tickets, ranks by narrower-scope-preferred + recency with deterministic ticket-id lexical tie-breaking, returns top-N=3 matches as JSON with an excluded_count field and a concise per-match summary {slug, missed_signal_summary, generalizable_lesson}, and supports an --output-file flag for ARG_MAX safety.
**Why**: This is the retrieval half of the loop; the test-writer prompts (draft-4) consume its output.
**Scope**:
- IN: lookup script; relevance ranking; staleness auto-check; promoted-tag exclusion; tie-breaking; top-3 JSON; excluded_count; concise summary; --output-file.
- OUT: prompt integration (draft-4); the end-to-end fixtures (draft-8).","priority":1,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["negative-examples-lookup.sh reads the task's file_impact and claimable_intent and queries closed bugs tagged negative-example and bug-type-<slug> via existing ticket-CLI primitives ← Satisfies: sc-3","Tickets carrying any promoted-to-standard:* tag are excluded, and tickets whose related_files reference paths absent on disk are excluded by an auto-staleness check ← Satisfies: sc-3","Results are ranked with narrower-scoped (smaller related_files) preferred and weighted by recency, and two examples with identical relevance scores are returned in deterministic ticket-id lexical order ← Satisfies: sc-3","Output is the top-3 matches as JSON including an excluded_count field and a per-match summary of exactly {slug, missed_signal_summary, generalizable_lesson}, and the script writes to the path given by --output-file when supplied (ARG_MAX-safe) ← Satisfies: sc-3","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-3"],"considerations":["[Dependency] EXTERNAL BLOCKER: slug taxonomy comes from 4911-c7ba; claimable_intent / manifest entries come from 94ed-f55c.","[Risk] Top-N cutoff can silence critical examples; excluded_count is the structural signal consumed by /dso:retro (draft-5).","[Determinism] Tie-breaking must be reproducible across runs — lexical ticket-id order, asserted by a RANKING_TIE fixture."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["5b87-836f-0f29-448c"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-3"},{"id":"a205-9bc8-24fa-4a0b","title":"As a test-writing sub-agent, I want the three test-writer prompts to invoke the lookup at task-start and inject learned patterns under an advisory label, so that I distinguish project-specific lessons from the universal 7-rule standard.","description":"## Description
**What**: Update plugins/dso/agents/red-test-writer.md, plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md, and the fix-bug RED-phase prompt (path under plugins/dso/skills/fix-bug/, resolved at implementation-plan) to invoke negative-examples-lookup.sh at task-start, inject retrieved examples under the label "## Project-specific learned patterns (advisory; not universal Rule 1-7+ authority)", cap at 3 examples per task, and omit the section entirely when 0 examples are returned (no empty block, no error).
**Why**: Closes the consumption side — test-writers actually see the learned lessons.
**Scope**:
- IN: three prompt edits; task-start lookup invocation; advisory label; 3-example cap; omit-on-empty behavior.
- OUT: the lookup script logic (draft-3); end-to-end fixtures (draft-8).","priority":1,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["All three named prompts (plugins/dso/agents/red-test-writer.md, plugins/dso/skills/sprint/prompts/task-execution.md, and the fix-bug RED-phase prompt) invoke negative-examples-lookup.sh at task-start ← Satisfies: sc-4","Retrieved examples are injected under the exact label "## Project-specific learned patterns (advisory; not universal Rule 1-7+ authority)" and capped at 3 examples per task ← Satisfies: sc-4","When the lookup returns 0 examples the learned-patterns section is omitted entirely with no empty block and no error ← Satisfies: sc-4","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-4"],"considerations":["[CrossEpic] EXTERNAL BLOCKER: d566-afa6 modifies the same three prompt files with Rule 6/7; merge-window protocol applies when both epics ship in overlapping sprints — coordinate edits, do not clobber d566's additions.","[Risk] The advisory label must read verbatim so agents do not treat learned patterns as universal-rule authority."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["1b37-8ba6-0639-4cc2"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-4"},{"id":"624d-edb3-71cc-44ed","title":"As a DSO maintainer, I want /dso:retro to surface graduation candidates from the negative-example corpus via frequency and cross-slug-predicate triggers with a sycophancy gate, so recurring lessons become draft universal rules","description":"## Description
**What**: Extend /dso:retro with a Graduation Phase where an opus sub-agent reads all negative-example bugs without a promoted-to-standard:* tag via a single CLI query and identifies candidates via (a) frequency floor (>=3 examples same bug_type_slug with distinct root-cause fingerprints, collapsing groups with >=80% missed_signal_summary similarity to one signal) and (b) cross-slug semantic match via a single falsifiable predicate naming a specific input state/code path AND expected observable outcome (theme-level labels rejected). Each candidate is surfaced with a 4-field draft rule, >=3 evidence_citations with quoted missed_signal_summary, and explicit provenance. A PRE-DRAFT validation checks existing behavioral-testing-standard.md rules and blocks surfacing on unresolved overlap. A SYCOPHANCY GATE on user acceptance requires a non-empty, non-restating answer to the distinct-coverage challenge before PR drafting, else marks the candidate challenged-rejected. Emits structured RETRO_TELEMETRY whose examples_extracted_since_last_retro and examples_skipped_count counters use a since-last-retro watermark.
**Why**: This is the promotion engine that turns accumulated examples into rule candidates.
**Scope**:
- IN: Graduation Phase logic; single CLI query; frequency-floor trigger + collapse; cross-slug falsifiable-predicate trigger; 4-field draft + evidence_citations + provenance; pre-draft conflict check; sycophancy gate; since-last-retro watermark; RETRO_TELEMETRY emission.
- OUT: the atomic PR-first graduation write + tagging (draft-6); the safeguard no-auto-commit assertion (draft-6); end-to-end fixtures (draft-8).","priority":2,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["The Graduation Phase reads all bugs tagged negative-example and lacking any whose examples are >=80% missed_signal_summary similar is collapsed to a single signal rather than counted as N ← Satisfies: sc-5","Cross-slug candidates are surfaced only via a single falsifiable predicate naming a specific input state or code path and an expected observable outcome, and theme-level labels are not surfaced ← Satisfies: sc-5","Each surfaced candidate carries a 4-field draft rule (rule_statement, rationale, anti_pattern_example, correct_pattern_example), at least 3 evidence_citations with quoted missed_signal_summary, and explicit provenance ← Satisfies: sc-5","A candidate overlapping an existing behavioral-testing-standard.md rule is blocked from surfacing unless revised-as-modification or justified-as-distinct ← Satisfies: sc-5","On user acceptance the sycophancy gate blocks PR drafting and marks the candidate challenged-rejected when the distinct-coverage answer is empty or merely restates the rule ← Satisfies: sc-5","The Graduation Phase emits RETRO_TELEMETRY with the specified counter fields on completion ← Satisfies: sc-5","The RETRO_TELEMETRY counters examples_extracted_since_last_retro and examples_skipped_count count only last-retro cursor ← Satisfies: sc-5","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-5"],"considerations":["[Dependency] EXTERNAL BLOCKER: pre-draft conflict check reads behavioral-testing-standard.md structure established by a03c-d55e; slug grouping uses 4911-c7ba taxonomy.","[Risk] Cross-slug over-clustering residual is opus self-assessment; the single-falsifiable-predicate constraint and sycophancy gate are the spec mitigations — assert both with THEME-only-rejection and empty-answer fixtures.","[CrossStory] The RETRO_TELEMETRY counters examples_extracted_since_last_retro and examples_skipped_count (SC9(l)) count NEGATIVE_EXAMPLE and SKIP_RECORD comments produced by draft-2 Phase G. Establish a 'since last retro' watermark mechanism (read the prior RETRO_TELEMETRY artifact/comment timestamp, or a stored last-retro cursor) and count only comments created after it; rely on the creation timestamp draft-2 stamps on those comments.","[CrossEpic] detected_by candidate-weighting signal lands with a34c-b345 observability epic; design the query so detected_by:<channel> filtering can be added without rework, but do not depend on it.","[Operational] SC5 sycophancy-gate firing is captured in-session per the epic operational-constraints table."],"scopeSplitCandidate":true,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["3256-ed96-73db-4012"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-5"},{"id":"8d62-f67c-2f29-4e3d","title":"As a DSO maintainer, I want reopening a tagged bug to automatically remove its negative-example tag, so that reopened bugs are excluded from lookup until re-extraction.","description":"## Description
**What**: Add a sentry on the ticket-transition hook so that a status transition closed->open on a bug carrying the negative-example tag automatically removes that tag. A reopened bug is consequently excluded from negative-examples-lookup.sh results.
**Why**: Prevents stale lessons from reopened (no-longer-resolved) bugs leaking into test-writer guidance.
**Scope**:
- IN: ticket-transition hook sentry for closed->open on negative-example-tagged bugs; tag removal; consequent lookup exclusion.
- OUT: the lookup script itself (draft-3); the twelve-scenario synthetic test (draft-8, which includes the reopening fixture).","priority":2,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["A status transition from closed to open on a bug carrying the negative-example tag removes the negative-example tag via the ticket-transition hook sentry ← Satisfies: sc-8","After such a reopening the bug is excluded from negative-examples-lookup.sh results ← Satisfies: sc-8","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-8"],"considerations":["[Risk] The sentry must fire only on closed->open (not on other transitions) and only when the negative-example tag is present, to avoid removing tags on unrelated transitions."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["1b37-8ba6-0639-4cc2"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-8"},{"id":"cfc3-30ff-b245-4c35","title":"As a DSO maintainer, I want graduation to draft the PR first and only then tag contributing bugs, never auto-editing the safeguard file, so that the behavioral-testing-standard amendment stays human-gated and free of phantom graduation records.","description":"## Description
**What**: Implement the atomic graduation write for an accepted candidate: the standard-amendment PR is drafted FIRST, and contributing bug tickets receive the promoted-to-standard:<rule-id> tag ONLY after PR creation succeeds (no tags if PR draft fails). behavioral-testing-standard.md remains a designated safeguard file: the Graduation Phase surfaces candidates and drafts rule text but MUST NOT auto-commit; human PR-merge approval remains required.
**Why**: Enforces atomic graduation ordering (SC6) and the safeguard-file no-auto-commit constraint (SC7), preventing phantom promotion records and protecting the safeguard boundary.
**Scope**:
- IN: PR-first draft of the standard amendment; promoted-to-standard:<rule-id> tagging gated on PR success with rollback semantics; assertion that no auto-commit to behavioral-testing-standard.md occurs; reviewer-assignment + deferred-merge handling per operational constraints.
- OUT: candidate identification / sycophancy gate (draft-5); lifecycle reopening hook (draft-7).","priority":2,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["On an accepted candidate the standard-amendment PR is created before any tagging, and promoted-to-standard:<rule-id> tags are applied to contributing bug tickets only after PR creation succeeds ← Satisfies: sc-6","When PR draft creation fails no promoted-to-standard tags are applied to any contributing ticket (no phantom graduation record) ← Satisfies: sc-6","The Graduation Phase produces the behavioral-testing-standard.md amendment only as PR content and performs no auto-commit or in-place write to the safeguard file ← Satisfies: sc-7","The opened amendment PR is assigned to a human reviewer and merge approval remains a required human step that graduation does not perform ← Satisfies: sc-7","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-6"],"considerations":["[Dependency] EXTERNAL BLOCKER: behavioral-testing-standard.md safeguard-file designation is owned by a03c-d55e SC2 / CLAUDE.md rule 22 — honor it, do not redefine it.","[Safeguard] CLAUDE.md rule 22 prohibits auto-editing safeguard files; graduation drafts a PR only — tests must assert no working-tree mutation of behavioral-testing-standard.md outside the PR branch.","[Operational] Per the epic operational-constraints table, sprint closure requires PR-opened + reviewer-assigned + a deferred-merge Phase I comment; in-session SC6 path is exercised against a synthetic fixture branch with gh PR create + close."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["624d-edb3-71cc-44ed"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-6;sc-7"},{"id":"16af-d9ec-b61b-456c","title":"As a DSO maintainer, I want a synthetic end-to-end test exercising all twelve calibration scenarios, so that the full record->lookup->graduate->lifecycle loop is verified in one configuration-isolated run.","description":"## Description
**What**: Build a synthetic end-to-end test covering the twelve SC9 scenarios (a) extraction+atomic write+audit, (b) skip recorded, (c) privacy redaction, (d) lookup stale-example exclusion, (e) frequency graduation with accept + PR + promoted tag, (f) frequency collapse (>=80% similar -> 1 signal), (g) cross-slug predicate graduation, (h) theme-only rejection, (i) sycophancy empty-answer block + challenged-rejected, (j) cold-start/empty-corpus omit-section, (k) ranking-tie deterministic lexical order, (l) operational metric emission of RETRO_TELEMETRY with all named counter fields.
**Why**: This is the integration proof that the closed-loop system works end to end across all four phases.
**Scope**:
- IN: twelve-scenario synthetic fixtures and assertions wiring draft-1..7 together.
- OUT: the individual unit behaviors (covered by draft-1..7).","priority":3,"classification":"new","walkingSkeleton":false,"hasWireframe":false,"doneDefinitions":["An integration test exercises the record->lookup->graduate->lifecycle loop in a configuration-isolated environment (HOME set to an empty directory, no pre-existing worktrees, no global git config, no environment variables pre-set from the developer's machine) and the test passes ← Satisfies: sc-9","The test asserts scenarios (a) extraction+atomic write+audit, (b) skip recorded, (c) privacy redaction, and (d) lookup stale-example exclusion each reach their specified outcomes ← Satisfies: sc-9","The test asserts scenarios (e) frequency graduation with accept+PR+promoted tag, (f) frequency collapse to one signal, (g) cross-slug predicate graduation, and (h) theme-only rejection each reach their specified outcomes ← Satisfies: sc-9","The test asserts scenarios (i) sycophancy empty-answer block marking challenged-rejected, (j) cold-start empty-corpus omitting the learned-patterns section with excluded_count=0, (k) ranking-tie deterministic lexical order, and (l) RETRO_TELEMETRY emission with all named counter fields each reach their specified outcomes ← Satisfies: sc-9","Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-9"],"considerations":["[Testing] SC9 is VALIDATION-CLASS / live-verified — the loop must be exercised against real ticket-CLI primitives and a synthetic fixture gh branch, not mocked-out internals, in a configuration-isolated environment.","[Dependency] This story integrates draft-1 through draft-7; it must run after all of them land.","[Operational] Scenario (e) and (l) exercise the gh PR-creation path on a synthetic fixture branch per the epic operational-constraints in-session verification."],"scopeSplitCandidate":false,"splitRole":null,"splitPairId":null,"blockedBy":["3256-ed96-73db-4012","1b37-8ba6-0639-4cc2","a205-9bc8-24fa-4a0b","624d-edb3-71cc-44ed","cfc3-30ff-b245-4c35","8d62-f67c-2f29-4e3d"],"satisfiesCriterion":"sc-9"}],"storyDashboard":{"totalStories":8,"uiStories":0,"criticalPath":["5b87-836f-0f29-448c","3256-ed96-73db-4012","624d-edb3-71cc-44ed","cfc3-30ff-b245-4c35"]}}
